snippet.title: Draw Directly in 3D Space! The worse you draw, the more fun! "SUPER GAHAKU" 1st Trailer
snippet.description:
Draw in 3D space! Create hilariously wonky sculptures from prompts, then laugh and guess what everyone was trying to make. The worse you are at drawing, the more fun it gets!

"SUPER GAHAKU"
Coming Fall 2026.

Check out our Steam page and add it to your wishlist!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4966560/SUPER_GAHAKU
